issues.summary: The local SC2 installation is missing Campaigns/Void.SC2Campaign, a declared dependency of the owned main Mod and faction packages.
issues.impact: A live SC2 load cannot be accepted, regardless of staging or process startup status.
issues.nextAction: Install the required official campaign data or provide an approved owned dependency replacement, then run the launcher with a runtime listener and same-window ScriptError gate.

issues.summary: Faction activation uses post-load chat triggers, so staging does not prove the selected faction replaced player-one units at runtime.
issues.impact: The UI may expose a valid preset that cannot yet be proven in an engine session.
issues.nextAction: After RO-PKG-001 is resolved, use the approved launcher to capture faction-specific unit state, runtime listener/heartbeat evidence, and ScriptError verdict.

issues.summary: Mission AI and alliance logic remain map-owned and need per-map roster evidence before a shared ally adapter can act on them.
issues.impact: A generic melee-AI replacement could break mission objectives or player ownership.
issues.nextAction: Complete Stage 04 roster extraction and deterministic AI ally contract tests.
